single.rationale: BILL shows strong operational momentum with improving profitability trajectory (turned GAAP profitable in FY25), impressive FCF generation (23.7% margin), and network effects in its SMB payment platform. However, macroeconomic headwinds impacting SMBs, slowing revenue growth (13% vs 31% 3-year CAGR), credit risk from charge card operations, and TPV-per-customer declines warrant careful monitoring before deeper commitment.
